role: Wind redistribution through the proposed eight in-plane arch/jamb frames. The vertical gravity quantities, moving guard, façade-normal bending/torsion, and soil response remain distinct from this wind update.
sourceCase: Four integration stiffness/bearing states, 96 directional wind cases each. The previous suction, retained-shell and maximum-G/Q forces are combined separately with the new wind; do not add independently governing head minima/maxima.
units: N columns positive compression in kN; first moments about physical global X and Y in kNm.
